description: Defines the data model class `RecentSearchQuery` representing a recent search query, and an extension function to convert from a database entity to this external model.

classes.name: RecentSearchQuery
classes.description: A data class representing a recent search query with a query string and the date it was queried.

methods.name: asExternalModel
methods.description: An extension function that converts a `RecentSearchQueryEntity` to a `RecentSearchQuery`.
